title: KinderCare Congratulates Indiana for Expanding Access to Child Care
summary: Thousands of families will soon have access to child care tuition support through a $200 million investment in state’s child care voucher program Key takeaways: KinderCare, a national leader in early childhood education, applauds Indiana’s $200 million investment to expand access to high-quality child care. As a trusted provider serving families across the country, KinderCare plays a critical role in delivering the kind of care and early learning experiences this funding supports. Expanded voucher funding will help more than 14,000 children access high-quality programs, including those offered by established providers like KinderCare. Investments in child care strengthen workforce participation and economic stability – outcomes KinderCare advances every day through its nationwide network of centers and educators.
